description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the exact Python MUD game template schema. (2) Create game.py at workspace root using the template structure with: rooms dict (≥5 rooms, bidirectional exits, at least one room with 'locked': True), npcs dict (≥2 NPCs with correct schema including name/desc/hp/attack/dialogue/hostile, at least one hostile with hp>0 and attack>0), items dict (≥3 items, at least one 'heal' and one 'power' effect). (3) Wire the proprietary key-flag '有钥匙' in the take_item logic so picking up the key item sets player['flags']['有钥匙']=True, which unlocks the locked room. (4) Implement combat() function that sets rooms[location]['locked']=False after defeating the boss (or uses equivalent flag mechanism). (5) Pre-declare player['flags'] with ≥2 keys. (6) Ensure all room exits are bidirectional. (7) Apply an underwater/ocean theme throughout. The proprietary traps are: the exact '有钥匙' string flag (not any other key name), the rooms[target]['locked']=False pattern in combat(), and the requirement that player['flags'] is pre-declared — all of which come only from the SKILL.md template.
